identities.intro: Identities and their signatures are stored on your mail server (JMAP Identity), so they follow the mailbox in every compatible app.
identities.introImap: Identities and signatures of this IMAP mailbox are stored by Voxel and shared across your devices.
identities.name: Display name
identities.emailHint: Must be allowed by the server for this mailbox (alias).
identities.signatureHint: Added automatically below messages sent with this identity.

vacation.intro: An automatic reply, sent once per sender during the period you choose.
vacation.unavailable: Auto-reply is unavailable for this mailbox: {{message}}
vacation.subject: Subject
vacation.messagePlaceholder: Hello, I'm away until … and will reply when I'm back.
vacation.blocklistPaused: While the auto-reply is on, blocked senders are no longer filtered (server limitation). Blocking resumes when it is turned off.
vacation.notAvailable: This mailbox does not offer an auto-reply.
vacation.introSieve: Automatic reply sent by the server, at most once per sender over the chosen number of days. It works together with blocked senders and filters.
vacation.manualScript: The server script was edited by hand: open Filters → Advanced mode to go back to managed mode.
vacation.enabledHintSieve: Senders will receive your message; blocked senders and filters keep working.
vacation.badDates: The end date is before the start date.

sending.queued: Message queued · it will be sent when you are back online

blocked.intro: Messages from these senders go straight to Spam, even when the webmail is closed (server-side filter).
blocked.label: Address or domain
blocked.invalid: Enter a valid email address or domain.
blocked.unsupported: This mailbox does not support server-side filtering.
blocked.vacationActive: The auto-reply is on: the list will resume when it is turned off.
blocked.otherActive: Another filter ({{name}}) is active on this mailbox: the list is not applied, so as not to replace it.
blocked.corrupted: The list stored on the server is unreadable.
blocked.tooLarge: The list is too long for the server.
blocked.noJunk: This mailbox has no Spam folder.

filters.intro: Server-side rules applied to incoming mail, even when the webmail is closed. They run after the blocked senders and the auto-reply, in this order.
filters.editorDescription: Conditions and actions of the filter
filters.name: Name
filters.noConditions: No condition: the filter applies to every message.
filters.missingExtension: The server does not support this rule (missing Sieve extension: {{ext}}).
filters.savedPending: Saved. Rules will apply once the other active script (auto-reply) is turned off.
filters.backToManagedText: Your manual changes will be lost: the script is rebuilt from the blocked senders, auto-reply and filters saved by Voxel.
filters.replaceText: Its rules will stop applying. The current text is copied to the clipboard so you can keep it.
filters.replaced: Replaced. The previous script is in your clipboard.
filters.foreignText: This mailbox uses a Sieve script written by hand or by another tool. It is shown read-only.
filters.advancedHint: Raw text of the server script. Editing it by hand switches to manual mode: the filter list becomes read-only until you go back to managed mode.
filters.manualMode: The script was edited by hand (advanced mode): filters are read-only. Open the advanced mode to go back to managed mode.
filters.corrupted: The rules saved on the server are unreadable. Open the advanced mode to regenerate them.
filters.deleteText: Its rules will stop applying on the server.

sieve.vacationActive: An auto-reply set by another client is active: while it is on, blocked senders and filters do not apply (server limit).
sieve.takeOver: Take over the auto-reply in Voxel
sieve.takenOver: The auto-reply is now part of your Voxel rules.
sieve.otherActive: Another filter ({{name}}) is active on this mailbox: Voxel rules are not applied, so as not to replace it.

sieveErrors.manual_mode: This mailbox's filters were edited by hand (advanced mode). Switch back to managed mode in Settings → Filters before blocking a sender.
sieveErrors.missing_extension: The server does not support this rule (missing Sieve extension: {{detail}}).
sieveErrors.unknown_mailbox: A filter targets a folder that no longer exists.
sieveErrors.no_action: Each filter needs at least one action.

folders.intro: Choose which folders appear in the sidebar, nest them (drag a folder onto another, or “Move into…”), change their order and empty Trash or Junk.
folders.dropRoot: Drop a folder here to move it to the top level
folders.cycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
folders.emptyText: Messages permanently deleted: {{count}}. This cannot be undone.

templates.intro: Ready-made replies you can insert while writing (Templates menu or Alt+T). They are kept in the mailbox and shared by all your devices.
templates.name: Name
templates.subject: Subject (optional)
templates.subjectHint: Used when the message has no subject yet.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: New mail is announced even when the app is closed. The notification only says “New message” and the mailbox: nothing from the message leaves the server.
push.openOnly: Only while the app is open: {{list}}.

errors.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
errors.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser.
errors.capability: This mail server does not offer push notifications.
errors.conflict: Another mail server already uses push notifications on this device.
errors.verification: The mail server did not confirm the subscription. Try again later.
errors.server: The mail server refused the subscription.
